_note: Trainer NPC definitions for tactical battles. Rosters send out sequentially as each creature faints; no trainer AI. pre_dialogue/post_dialogue are wiring placeholders — the story bot owns trainer voice.

c1_tidehunter.name: TIDE HUNTER
post_dialogue: The river chose you. For now.
Spend those credits well. You'll earn them back in scars.
pre_dialogue: The river gives, hunter. The river also takes.
Three of mine. Show me what the new reaper's made of.

p3_scavenger.name: SHORE SCAVENGER
post_dialogue: Take the credits. The shore provides.
pre_dialogue: Oi. You walk like a reaper. Prove it.
My scavenged pair against yours. No running.

wrath_rival_1.name: WRATH
pre_dialogue: So. The new reaper finally crawled out of the river.
I've read your tally. One stray. How... tender.
Let's see if you can do more than shepherd.
post_dialogue: ...Huh. Maybe the river didn't make a mistake.
Don't get comfortable. I'm taking the contracts you pass up.
Next time, I won't be pulling my strikes.
post_dialogue_loss: Stay out of my way, little reaper.
